product: Apple for Business — device fleet pricing
billing: per device, one-time purchase or 24-month lease via Apple Financial Services; volume pricing applies automatically above 20 units on a single order

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.price_per_device: MacBook Air (M3) from $949/device (5% volume discount); iPhone 16 from $759/device

tiers.name: Enterprise
features: custom fleet pricing based on device mix and term
trade-in program for the old fleet
tiers.note: Custom quote required above 100 devices; final price depends on device mix (Mac/iPhone/iPad ratio), lease vs. purchase, and trade-in credit for the existing fleet.

financing_note: Apple Financial Services offers 24-month business leasing as an alternative to upfront purchase — ask about it if budget, not total cost, is the blocker.
